backend/main.mo: Main backend actor implementing a grocery store system with user profiles, product management, orders, mobile recharges, shopping carts, billing, and admin authorization using AccessControl and Storage mixins.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting two high-confidence features: debugging admin panel access issues in AdminGuard and isAdmin method, and adding error logging with user-friendly messages to AdminGuard.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of all frontend files including components, pages, hooks, and routing setup for the grocery store application with admin panel, cart, checkout, and mobile recharge features.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for light and dark themes, defining colors for UI components including sidebar, charts, and semantic tokens.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with PWA meta tags, app icons, manifest link, and mobile-optimized viewport settings for Maa Bhawani General Store application.
frontend/public/manifest.json: PWA manifest defining app metadata, icons, display mode (standalone), theme colors, and orientation for Maa Bhawani General Store mobile app.
frontend/public/service-worker.js: Service worker implementing cache-first strategy for static assets and network-first strategy for API calls, with cache management and offline fallback support.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app component configuring TanStack Router with routes for home, checkout, order confirmation, store details, admin panel, billing, and settings pages.
frontend/src/components/AdminGuard.tsx: Authorization wrapper component that verifies admin access with comprehensive state logging, loading states for identity/actor initialization, detailed error messages with retry functionality, and user-friendly access denied messages including contact information.
frontend/src/components/AdminProductForm: Form component for adding new products with fields for name, category, price, barcode, and image upload. Includes validation, duplicate barcode checking, upload progress tracking, and toast notifications.
frontend/src/components/AdminProductList: Displays a table of all products with images, details, and delete functionality. Includes loading skeletons and confirmation dialog for product deletion.
frontend/src/components/BillHistoryTable: Table component showing all generated bills with search/filter functionality, view/print actions, and CSV export capability. Formats dates and times for display.
frontend/src/components/BillTemplate.tsx: Printable bill template component displaying shop details, customer info, itemized purchases, and totals in a thermal printer-friendly 80mm format.
frontend/src/components/CallUsButton.tsx: Fixed floating action button in bottom-right corner that initiates a phone call to the shop number (9142876085).
frontend/src/components/CartDrawer.tsx: Side drawer component displaying cart items with quantities, prices, and actions for checkout or clearing cart. Includes swipe-to-close gesture support.
frontend/src/components/CategoryFilter.t: Horizontal scrollable button list for filtering products by category with active state highlighting.
Alert component displaying delivery policy information (free within 1km, ₹20/km beyond).
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Site footer with shop information, contact details, Google Maps link, delivery info, and attribution to caffeine.ai with UTM tracking.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Header component with navigation, cart drawer toggle, and Internet Identity login/logout functionality. Displays store logo, navigation links, cart item count badge, and authentication button.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Layout wrapper component that provides the page structure with Header, Footer, CallUsButton, and a main content area with gradient background.
frontend/src/components/MobileRechargeSe: Mobile recharge form component with banner image, allowing users to enter mobile number, select operator, and submit recharge orders. Validates input and requires authentication.
frontend/src/components/PaymentQRCode.ts: Payment QR code display component showing the amount to pay, a QR code image, and step-by-step UPI payment instructions.
frontend/src/components/ProductCard.tsx: Product card component displaying product image, name, category badge, price, and an add-to-cart button. Requires authentication to add items.
frontend/src/components/ProductGrid.tsx: Product grid component with category filtering that displays all products in a responsive grid layout. Shows loading skeletons while fetching data.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and manages the backend actor instance based on Internet Identity authentication state. Initializes access control with admin token and invalidates queries on actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Internet Identity authentication provider and hook managing login/logout state, identity persistence, and AuthClient configuration with delegation validation.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Collection of React Query hooks for data fetching and mutations including products, cart operations, orders, recharge orders, and bills management with proper cache invalidation.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for a warm, earthy color palette (browns, creams, oranges) for both light and dark modes, plus touch-friendly button styles and print-specific styles for 80mm thermal bill printing.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React root with QueryClient for data fetching and InternetIdentityProvider for authentication, then renders the main App component.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPage.tsx: Admin dashboard page displaying overview statistics (products, orders, bills, revenue) with tabs for managing products, orders, recharges, and bills, plus navigation to billing and settings pages.
frontend/src/pages/AdminSettingsPage.tsx: Admin settings page for customizing shop slogan that appears on bills, with a live preview using a mock bill template and form to save changes.
frontend/src/pages/BillingPage.tsx: Admin billing interface supporting manual barcode entry or camera scanning to add products to a bill, with customer details input, quantity management, and bill generation/printing functionality.
frontend/src/pages/CheckoutPage.tsx: Customer checkout page collecting delivery details (name, phone, address, distance), calculating total price with delivery fees, and placing orders with validation and navigation to confirmation.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Main storefront page displaying a hero banner image, mobile recharge section, and product grid for browsing and shopping groceries.
frontend/src/pages/OrderConfirmationPage: Order confirmation page showing success message with order ID, payment QR code, next steps instructions, and options to continue shopping or call the store.
frontend/src/pages/StoreDetailsPage.tsx: React component displaying store information including contact details, location map, delivery policy, store hours, and services offered for Maa Bhawani General Store & Banking Point.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting, storing, and managing URL parameters from both regular query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom color scheme using OKLCH color space, container settings, border radius variables, animations, and typography/container-queries plugins.
project_state.json: Project metadata tracking e-commerce grocery store app features, known issues (admin panel access, payment gateway, OTP/GPS build failures), and pending feature requests for flexible quantity input, payment integration, and authentication fixes.
